Spacebar CPS Test: Boost Your Clicking Speed with Voyager Game

Are you ready to calculate your exact clicking speed? Welcome to the ultimate Spacebar CPS Test (Clicks Per Second) packed inside an immersive interstellar arcade trainer.

What is a CPS Test and Why Does it Matter?

CPS stands for Clicks Per Second. It is a core metric used by competitive pro-gamers to measure raw reflex velocity and finger stamina.

How to Test and Improve Your Clicks Per Second Score

  • Real-time Tracking: Monitor your live CPS directly inside the upper HUD panel.
  • Stamina Training: Rhythmic click patterns regulate engine propulsion.
  • Peak Score Analytics: The post-game screen displays your maximum Peak CPS.
💡 Did You Know?The average global CPS sits between 4–6.5. Professional esports veterans frequently breach sustained ranges of 12–15 clicks per second!

Boss Asteroids and Long-Run Endurance

Every 90 seconds a Boss Asteroid fills most of the vertical play field. Clearing one unlocks the "Boss Slayer" achievement.

Understanding Your Power-Up Loadout

Five collectible power-ups: Shield, Invincibility, Slow-Mo, Double Boost, and Multiplier.

Reading the Near-Miss Window

A near miss registers when an asteroid passes close without collision, building your combo multiplier.
